parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Answer every question: Yes, No or ?. Press ? if you do not know. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer.

items.q: Anna isn’t a woman; she’s a ____ .
I’m taking the pen ____ the table.
Jack: “____ pencil’s yellow?” Anna: “This pencil’s yellow.”
The letter L is ____ M and N.
____ are three books on that table.
Please translate these English words ____ French.
There aren’t ____ coats in the room.

parts.title: Part 4 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word.

items.text: She isn’t speaking French; is speaking English.
What’s the difference Beijing and China?
How many clock are there in this room?
Mr and Mrs Brown has a large house.
I can’t to touch the ceiling.
Walter speak German with his family.

parts.text: The pen is long. The pencil is short. The book is on the table. The clock is in front of you. I am standing on the floor. Anna is a girl. Jack is a boy. The window is open. The door is closed. There are three books on the table. This pencil is red. That chair is black. They are sitting in the room. We are standing in front of the house. The wall is high. Mr Brown is tall. I can touch my nose. I can’t touch the ceiling. I like my city. She speaks English. He goes home after the lesson. Touch your head, please. Open your book. Where’s the teacher?
